Jordan: PTAL on PR #4213 — addressed the kv-cache eviction nits and added a smoke test. I pushed a tiny refactor per @Alex's suggestion. Can someone give a 2nd approve? need canary slot tomorrow 9am PT. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4213 :rocket:
Meera: I'll skim now, can I merge after CI green?
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed (build, unit, smoke). https://ci.example.com/build/4213
Alex: LGTM on the changes I flagged earlier. Couple tiny comments inline but non-blocking. I'll give formal approve once smoke artifacts are attached.
Jordan: added smoke artifacts to the PR and a simple run command in the PR description:
```bash
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --model small --seed 42
```
Sasha: quick Q — does this change require a db migration? I didn't see one in the diff.
Jordan: no migrations, just allocator logic change in runtime. Verified locally with --no-migrate.
Meera: PTAL now done, leaving approve. @Alex you good to approve so we can grab tomorrow's canary?
Alex: approving now :thumbsup:
Jordan: thanks all — scheduling canary at 2026-03-19T16:00Z (tomorrow 9am PT) and will monitor. If anything pops up, I'll post in #eng-oncall.
ci-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary at 2026-03-19T16:00:00Z
Sasha: nice, will watch logs.
